summary: Master the art of recruitment with our specialized training course for HR professionals. Learn proven selection techniques to streamline your hiring process.
lede: Recruitment and Selection Techniques for HR Professionals helps you build a repeatable approach to defining vacancies, attracting candidates, screening applications, conducting structured interviews, and selecting role-fit candidates. You will develop practical skills in selection criteria, competency mapping, interview scoring, reference checking, and evidence-based recommendation writing. Through workshop exercises, you will create job description refinements, sourcing plans, screening matrices, interview scorecards, and hiring documentation. The course also introduces psychometric testing concepts, applicant tracking workflows, AI-assisted sourcing use cases, and operational approaches to digital hiring and recruitment analytics.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who run or influence hiring decisions and need stronger recruitment and selection techniques in daily HR work.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of HR processes, recruitment workflows, and basic interview practice. You do not need coding skills. Familiarity with job descriptions, candidate screening, and hiring manager coordination will help you move faster through the applied exercises. Advanced concepts such as psychometric assessment and AI-assisted sourcing are taught at an operational application level, not as technical engineering.
